name: evb-viewer
author: Eugene Barsky <34789976+evb0110@users.noreply.github.com>
description: EVB Viewer - a PDF and DjVu document viewer

scripts.start: pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electronRun.ts start
scripts.dev: pnpm electron:run stop --session=default --keep-nuxt && pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electronRun.ts start
scripts.dev:headless: pnpm run electron:run:headless -- stop --session=default --keep-nuxt && pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run electron:run:headless -- start
scripts.build: pnpm exec nuxi build && node scripts/prune-build-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/check-web-deploy-assets.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run check:wasm:portable && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:pdf-image-combine && pnpm run build:pdf-page-ops && pnpm run build:pdf-search
scripts.postinstall: pnpm exec nuxi prepare && pnpm run copy:pdfjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:app && pnpm run typecheck:electron && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run typecheck:scripts && pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run typecheck:server
scripts.typecheck:packages: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/pdf-core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/i18n-core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/i18n-app/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/release-selection/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives && stylelint "app/**/*.{vue,scss,css}" && pnpm run check:style-assets && pnpm run check:pdfjs-viewer-css && pnpm run check:css-custom-properties && pnpm run check:css-important && pnpm run check:web-deploy-source && pnpm run check:locales && pnpm run check:icons:bundle && pnpm run check:commonjs-imports && pnpm run check:dependency-lockstep && pnpm run check:ocr-language-model-registry && pnpm run check:vendor-sync && pnpm run check:naming
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix --max-warnings=0 && stylelint "app/**/*.{vue,scss,css}" && pnpm run check:style-assets && pnpm run check:pdfjs-viewer-css && pnpm run check:css-custom-properties && pnpm run check:css-important && pnpm run check:web-deploy-source && pnpm run check:locales && pnpm run check:icons:bundle && pnpm run check:commonjs-imports && pnpm run check:dependency-lockstep && pnpm run check:ocr-language-model-registry && pnpm run check:vendor-sync && pnpm run check:naming
scripts.lint:all: eslint . --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives && stylelint "app/**/*.{vue,scss,css}" && pnpm run check:style-assets:all && pnpm run check:pdfjs-viewer-css && pnpm run check:css-custom-properties && pnpm run check:css-important:all && pnpm run check:web-deploy-source && pnpm run check:locales:all && pnpm run check:icons:bundle:all && pnpm run check:commonjs-imports && pnpm run check:dependency-lockstep && pnpm run check:ocr-language-model-registry && pnpm run check:vendor-sync && pnpm run check:naming:all && pnpm --dir landing run lint
scripts.fallow:all: pnpm run fallow && pnpm run fallow:dupes
scripts.validate: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run typecheck:coverage && pnpm run build:strict && pnpm run fallow:all && pnpm run check:architecture
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:coverage:run && pnpm run check:coverage-ratchet
scripts.test:bundle-integrity: pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --project bundle-integrity && node scripts/prune-build-artifacts.mjs && pnpm run check:build-artifacts:hygiene
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path native/pdf-image-combine/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path native/pdf-page-ops/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path native/pdf-search/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.test:e2e:electron: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run test:e2e:electron:smoke:no-build
scripts.test:e2e:electron:draw-shapes: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run test:e2e:electron:draw-shapes:no-build
scripts.test:e2e:electron:large: EVB_E2E_REQUIRE_LARGE_PDF_FIXTURE=1 pnpm run build:electron && EVB_E2E_REQUIRE_LARGE_PDF_FIXTURE=1 pnpm run test:e2e:electron:large:no-build
scripts.test:e2e:electron:quarantine: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run test:e2e:electron:quarantine:no-build
scripts.test:e2e:electron:headless: EVB_AUTOMATION_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 EVB_AUTOMATION_HIDE_WINDOW=0 xvfb-run -a pnpm run test:e2e:electron
scripts.diag:pdf-navigation-blink-trace: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec tsx scripts/diagnostics/pdfNavigationBlinkTrace.ts
scripts.diag:pdf-skeleton-navigation: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec tsx scripts/diagnostics/runPdfSkeletonNavigationDiagnostics.ts
scripts.diag:arnold-pdf-open: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm exec tsx scripts/diagnostics/runArnoldPdfOpenDiagnostics.ts
scripts.diag:pdf-tabs:ci: sh -c 'pnpm electron:run stop --session=pdf-tabs-ci >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pnpm run build:electron && pnpm electron:run startd --session=pdf-tabs-ci && pnpm diag:pdf-tabs --session pdf-tabs-ci --tabs 4 --cycles 3 --gc --sample-heap --max-inactive-canvases 0 --max-inactive-rendered-pages 0 --max-inactive-djvu-images 0 --max-inactive-canvas-pixels 0; status=$?; pnpm electron:run stop --session=pdf-tabs-ci >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit $status'
scripts.check:architecture: pnpm run check:architecture:dep-graph && pnpm run check:architecture:boundaries && pnpm run check:architecture:source-size
scripts.check:architecture:all: pnpm run check:architecture:dep-graph:all && pnpm run check:architecture:boundaries:all
